name: Rose Belle Data Centre
notes: Mauritius Telecom/my.t and RBDC describe the Rose Belle Tier IV Data Centre in the south of Mauritius with 1,500 sq m of secured rack space, up to 400+ racks, and 3 MW of power; Uptime Institute lists Rose Belle Data Centre Phase 1 for Mauritius Telecom at Rose Belle.

name: Bhumishq Data Centre / Cybercity Data Centre
developer: Bhumishq Technologies Ltd / Bhumi Fund Ltd
notes: Prodesign says the 500 sq m Bhumishq data centre is part of MINDSPACE in Ebene and was completed in 2010; Data Center Map lists it in Reduit/Ebene, and Uptime Institute lists the Cybercity Data Centre client as Bhumishq Teleserve. Administrative boundary between Ebene/Reduit and Plaines Wilhems/Moka is ambiguous in public listings, so assigned to Moka via Reduit market evidence.

name: Millenium Outsourcing Ebene / Millenium Internet Exchange Ebene
notes: Inflect lists Millenium Internet Exchange Ebene as a state-of-the-art data center operated by Millenium Outsourcing Ltd at Julius Nyerere Avenue, Moka VCA West 72201; operator site confirms Millenium Outsourcing address at Level 3, Alexander House, 35 Cybercity, Ebene, but does not independently detail data-center specifications.

name: Emtel Business Data Centre
notes: Official Emtel page describes a purpose-built Tier-3 certified data centre with 100% uptime since 2012, direct access to METISS, SAFE, and LION/LION2 submarine cables, and strategic location in Arsenal, North Mauritius. Page mentions dual 1 MW transformers, but not IT capacity, so capacity_mw is null.

name: Aphelion DC3
notes: Data Center Map lists Aphelion DC3 at Noah Wealth Center, JinFei Smart City, Terre Rouge, Pamplemousses; Upstack describes the JinFei Smart City Internet Data Center as Tier 3 equivalent and built in 2015. Operator site confirms Aphelion cloud/managed-services business but does not publish facility details.

name: Rogers Capital La Tour Koenig Data Center
notes: Rogers Capital official page states it operates carrier-neutral data centres in Ebene and La Tour Koenig; Data Center Map lists the La Tour Koenig facility at La Tour Koenig Informatics Park, 36 Andreanum Ave, Port Louis, with a 2016 rebrand from EIS to Rogers Capital Technology Services.

name: Rogers Capital Port Louis Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists a Rogers Capital Port Louis Data Center at 59 Mere Barthelemy St; Rogers Capital official page corroborates local data-centre services but not this individual street-level facility page.

name: Rogers Capital Les Cascades Data Center
notes: Data Center Map nearest-facility listing identifies Rogers Capital Les Cascades Data Center at Les Cascades Building, Edith Cavell Street, Port Louis; Rogers Capital official page confirms the operator runs carrier-neutral data centres in Mauritius, but public details for this specific facility are sparse.

name: Harel Mallac Technologies Data Center
notes: Data Center Map nearest-facility listing identifies Harel Mallac Technologies Data Center at 18 Edith Cavell Street, Port Louis. Treated as directory-supported operational evidence; capacity and specifications not found in public primary sources during this pass.

name: Cloudflare Port Louis Data Center
notes: Cloudflare official blog announced Port Louis, Mauritius as a Cloudflare network data-center city in March 2018. This is a CDN/edge network location rather than a published colocation facility; physical host facility and capacity not disclosed.

name: Rose Hill Data Centre
notes: Mauritius Telecom/my.t colocation page describes the Rose Hill Tier III compliant Data Centre in central Mauritius with 300 sq m of secured rack space, up to 60+ racks, and 500 kW of power.

name: Rogers Capital Ebene Data Center
notes: Rogers Capital official page states its carrier-neutral data centre in Ebene hosts the extended Mauritius Internet Exchange Point; Data Center Map places the facility at Cyber Tower 1, Ebene Cybercity, Quatre Bornes, Plaine Wilhems. DC Hub reports 3.0 MW power, used for capacity_mw but treated as third-party capacity evidence.

name: BIRGER Candos Recovery Centre
notes: Data Center Map lists BIRGER Candos Recovery Centre at Royal Road, Candos, Quatre Bornes, with 24/7 operation and hosted servers; BIRGER official site describes data centres with work-area recovery services. Telecom Review Africa also names the BIRGER Candos Recovery Center in Quatre Bornes.

name: Kaldera Ebene Data Center
notes: Kaldera official page advertises data-centre, dedicated-server, cloud, managed-infrastructure, and business-internet services from Nexsky Building, Hotel Avenue, Cybercity, Ebene. Public capacity not found.

name: Lottotech Data Centre
notes: Prodesign project page says it provided full M&E design for two Lottotech data centres, including cooling, power distribution, fire suppression, data/communications and security systems; one project included a 90 sq m server room at HSBC Centre in Ebene Cybercity and was completed in October 2010.

name: Apollo Bramwell Data Centre
notes: Prodesign says it was appointed M&E consultant for the Apollo Bramwell Data Centre project, providing full M&E design/supervision and EIA preparation; start date 2008 and end date 2009. Listed as an enterprise/captive data-centre project; public capacity not found.

name: Standard Bank Data Centre
notes: Prodesign project page states it provided consultancy services for Standard Bank's Data Centre. Specific location and capacity were not found; grouped under Plaines Wilhems because Prodesign's Mauritius data-center project cluster and related Ebene projects are concentrated there.
